text:
Which statements about hydrogen–oxygen fuel cells are correct?
1
They convert chemical energy into electrical energy.
2
Hydrogen is reduced in the fuel cells.
3
They do not produce any atmospheric pollutants.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
